name: PM Surya Ghar: Muft Bijli Yojana

ministry.name: Ministry of New and Renewable Energy
ministry.department: Ministry of New and Renewable Energy

overview: A scheme to promote rooftop solar installations for residential households, providing subsidy to enable households to receive up to 300 units of free electricity per month.
objectives: Promote rooftop solar adoption among households
Enable free/subsidised electricity for eligible households
Reduce carbon emissions through renewable energy adoption

benefits.title: Subsidy on Rooftop Solar
benefits.description: Central financial assistance for installing rooftop solar systems

benefits.title: Free Electricity
benefits.description: Up to 300 units of free electricity per month for eligible households

otherCriteria: Indian households with a suitable rooftop for solar installation and valid electricity connection

customQuestions.question: Are you a residential electricity consumer?
Do you have a valid residential electricity connection from a DISCOM?
Is the rooftop solar system being installed for your residential electricity connection?
Are you installing a grid-connected rooftop solar (RTS) system on your roof, terrace, balcony or other eligible elevated structure?
Is the installation being carried out through an eligible/empanelled vendor under the scheme?
Will the installed solar modules satisfy the scheme's Domestic Content Requirement (DCR) for CFA eligibility?
Are you applying for CFA through the National Portal / prescribed DISCOM process?
Has the proposed installation already received CFA/subsidy under an earlier rooftop-solar scheme for the same capacity?
Will the rooftop system undergo the required DISCOM inspection/verification and metering process?

applicationProcess.description: Register on the PM Surya Ghar portal
Apply through DISCOM for feasibility approval
Install rooftop solar plant via empanelled vendor
Subsidy credited after commissioning and net metering

faqs.question: How much electricity is free?
faqs.answer: Up to 300 units per month depending on system capacity.

faqs.question: What is the subsidy amount?
faqs.answer: Central subsidy based on system capacity, as per current notified rates.

name: Namami Gange Programme

ministry.name: Ministry of Jal Shakti
ministry.department: Department of Water Resources, River Development and Ganga Rejuvenation

overview: An integrated conservation mission to accomplish effective abatement of pollution, conservation and rejuvenation of the National River Ganga.
objectives: Reduce pollution load in the Ganga river
Rejuvenate the ecological and biological health of the river
Build sewage treatment infrastructure along the Ganga basin

benefits.title: Sewage Infrastructure
benefits.description: Construction of sewage treatment plants along the Ganga basin

benefits.title: River Front Development
benefits.description: Development of ghats and crematoria and afforestation along riverbanks

otherCriteria: Programme benefits communities in the Ganga basin states

customQuestions.question: Do you live in a city, town or village within the Ganga River basin covered by a Namami Gange intervention?
Is your village/Gram Panchayat located along the River Ganga or an identified Ganga tributary covered by the programme?
Are you seeking a service or intervention related to river pollution, sanitation, sewage management or river conservation under Namami Gange?
Are you a resident of a Ganga Gram/identified village covered by a rural sanitation or related Namami Gange intervention?
Are you part of a local community, institution or organisation participating in an approved Ganga conservation/public-awareness activity?
Are you a research institution, academic institution or organisation seeking participation in an approved Namami Gange research/technology initiative?
If you are an implementing agency/local authority, is your proposed project located within the eligible Ganga basin/intervention area?

Is your proposed project related to an eligible Namami Gange activity such as sewerage treatment, pollution abatement, riverfront development, biodiversity, afforestation or related conservation work?

applicationProcess.description: Project proposals identified by state/urban local bodies
Approval by National Mission for Clean Ganga
Implementation and monitoring of pollution abatement projects

faqs.question: Which river does this programme target?
faqs.answer: The National River Ganga and its tributaries.

faqs.question: Which ministry implements Namami Gange?
faqs.answer: Ministry of Jal Shakti through the National Mission for Clean Ganga.

name: National Mission for a Green India (Green India Mission)

ministry.name: Ministry of Environment, Forest and Climate Change
ministry.department: Ministry of Environment, Forest and Climate Change

overview: A mission under the National Action Plan on Climate Change aimed at protecting, restoring and enhancing India's diminishing forest cover and responding to climate change.
objectives: Increase forest and tree cover across the country

benefits.title: Afforestation Support
benefits.description: Funding for afforestation, agroforestry and forest ecosystem restoration projects

benefits.title: Livelihood Support
benefits.description: Support for forest-dependent community livelihoods through sustainable practices

otherCriteria: Implemented in identified forest and non-forest landscapes across states

customQuestions.question: Do you live in or depend on a forest/forest-fringe or identified GIM intervention landscape?
Is your village/community located within an area identified in the State's Green India Mission perspective/implementation plan?
Are you a member of a local community, Gram Sabha, Joint Forest Management Committee or other recognised community institution involved in GIM activities?
Are you a forest-dependent, marginal or landless household that may be included in a GIM community-beneficiary list?
Are you a woman or member of a vulnerable/backward community participating in a GIM activity?
Is your land or community land located within an approved GIM afforestation/ecosystem-restoration intervention area?
Are you willing to participate in planning, restoration, protection or monitoring activities under the relevant GIM project?
If you are applying as a State Government/Forest Department/implementing institution, is the proposed activity included in the State's approved GIM plan?
If the activity concerns community resources, has the required Gram Sabha/community consultation and participation been completed?

applicationProcess.description: State Forest Department prepares Perspective/Annual Plans
Implementation through Joint Forest Management Committees

faqs.question: What is the goal of Green India Mission?
faqs.answer: Increase forest/tree cover and improve quality of existing forests.

faqs.question: Who implements the mission on ground?
faqs.answer: State Forest Departments through Joint Forest Management Committees.

name: Swachh Bharat Mission (Grameen and Urban)

ministry.name: Ministry of Jal Shakti / Ministry of Housing and Urban Affairs
ministry.department: Department of Drinking Water and Sanitation

overview: A national mission to achieve open-defecation-free status, improve solid and liquid waste management, and ensure cleanliness across rural and urban India.
objectives: Eliminate open defecation through toilet construction
Ensure scientific solid and liquid waste management
Promote behavioural change for cleanliness and hygiene

benefits.title: Toilet Construction Support
benefits.description: Financial assistance for construction of individual household toilets

benefits.title: Waste Management Infrastructure
benefits.description: Support for solid and liquid waste management systems in villages and towns

otherCriteria: Households without access to toilets; urban local bodies and gram panchayats for infrastructure components

customQuestions.question: Do you live in a rural village/Gram Panchayat?
Do you live in an urban area/Urban Local Body (ULB) covered by SBM-Urban?
Does your household not have access to a functional household toilet?
Is your household included in the eligible household/beneficiary list or approved citizen application for the relevant SBM intervention?
Are you seeking assistance for individual household toilet (IHHL) construction under the applicable SBM component?
Are you seeking a service related to solid waste management, liquid/grey-water management or sanitation in your village?
If you are an urban resident, is the sanitation/waste-management service available through your ULB under SBM-Urban?
Are you a sanitation worker/waste picker who falls within an applicable SBM intervention or support programme?
If you are applying for a community sanitation facility, does the community/location satisfy the applicable SBM requirements?
If you are a village/Gram Panchayat, does the village have the required arrangements for ODF sustainability, solid waste management and liquid waste management under SBM-G Phase II?

applicationProcess.description: Household registers for toilet construction with Gram Panchayat/ULB
Incentive amount disbursed on completion of toilet

faqs.question: What incentive is given for toilet construction?
faqs.answer: Financial assistance as notified under the scheme, disbursed after verified construction.

faqs.question: What are the two components of SBM?
faqs.answer: Swachh Bharat Mission-Grameen for rural areas and Swachh Bharat Mission-Urban for cities.

name: Pradhan Mantri Kisan Urja Suraksha evam Utthaan Mahabhiyan (PM-KUSUM)

ministry.name: Ministry of New and Renewable Energy
ministry.department: Ministry of New and Renewable Energy

overview: A scheme to promote solar energy adoption among farmers by supporting installation of solar pumps and grid-connected solar power plants on barren land, reducing dependence on diesel and grid power.
objectives: Provide clean energy access to farmers for irrigation
Enable farmers to generate additional income through solar power
Reduce diesel dependency in the agricultural sector

benefits.title: Solar Pump Subsidy
benefits.description: Financial assistance for installation of standalone solar-powered agricultural pumps

benefits.title: Solarisation of Existing Pumps
benefits.description: Support to solarise existing grid-connected agricultural pumps

otherCriteria: Individual farmers, farmer groups, panchayats and water user associations

customQuestions.question: Are you a farmer or eligible farmer group/entity interested in PM-KUSUM?

Are you interested in Component A, B or C of PM-KUSUM?  A / B / C  One must apply  3  For Component A, are you an individual farmer, group of farmers, cooperative, Panchayat, FPO or Water User Association?
For Component A, do you have suitable land for setting up a renewable-energy power plant?
For Component A, is the proposed renewable-energy plant within the eligible capacity range of 500 kW to 2 MW?
For Component B, do you have an agricultural irrigation requirement and need a standalone solar agricultural pump?
For Component B, is your agricultural area in an off-grid area where the agricultural pump is not connected to the grid?
For Component C, do you have an existing grid-connected agricultural pump?
If applying for feeder-level solarisation under Component C, is your agricultural pump connected to a feeder selected for solarisation under the State's approved programme?
Are you willing to provide the required land, pump, electricity-connection and ownership documents, as applicable to your component?
Is the PM-KUSUM component you are applying for implemented/allocated in your State or area?
Are you willing to follow the applicable State/DISCOM/implementing-agency application and verification process?

applicationProcess.description: Apply through state renewable energy development agency portal

faqs.question: What are the components of PM-KUSUM?
faqs.answer: Component A (solar plants on barren land), B (standalone solar pumps) and C (solarisation of grid-connected pumps).

faqs.question: What subsidy is available?
faqs.answer: Central and state subsidy covering a significant share of the cost, with farmer contributing the remainder.
